digest.component_or_area: reconciler git integration / tickets-branch commit seam
propositions: _commit_binding_store_snapshot currently composes git_adapter.add and git_adapter.commit outside the locked transaction, staging .bridge_state/last-pass.json which should not be committed and causes HEAD to advance on unchanged passes
test_unchanged_second_pass_preserves_binding_store_bytes_and_head fails when all uncommitted tracker files are staged with git add -A because per-pass timestamp file is included in the commit
the pathspec-scoped staging seam must preserve per-file idempotency: only the 5 named .bridge_state files should be staged and committed, never -A wildcarding

_commit_binding_store_snapshot must fail open with False + stderr + dedup'd bridge_alerts on any seam failure (stage/commit/lock-timeout/rebase-guard), matching the existing exception handler contract
commit_tickets_branch must be exported as a locked, commit-only helper that accepts optional paths pathspec for selective staging, without performing push
